arxiv-2506-03974.title: A Generic Branch-and-Bound Algorithm for ℓ 0 \ell_{0} -Penalized Problems with Supplementary Material
arxiv-2506-03974.creator: Clément Elvira, Théo Guyard, Cédric Herzet
arxiv-2506-03974.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Clément Elvira, Théo Guyard, Cédric Herzet. We present a generic Branch-and-Bound procedure designed to solve ℓ 0 \ell_{0} -penalized optimization problems. Existing approaches primarily focus on quadratic losses and construct relaxations using “Big-M” constraints and/or ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -norm penalties. In contrast, our method accommodates a broader class of loss functions and allows greater flexibility in relaxation design through a general penalty term, encompassing existing techniques as special cases.

arxiv-2511-17258.title: Enforcing governing equation constraints in neural PDE solvers via training-free projections
arxiv-2511-17258.creator: Omer Rochman Sharabi, Gilles Louppe
arxiv-2511-17258.description: Abstract Neural PDE solvers used for scientific simulation often violate governing equation constraints. While linear constraints can be projected cheaply, many constraints are nonlinear, complicating projection onto the feasible set. Dynamical PDEs are especially difficult because constraints induce long-range dependencies in time.

arxiv-2602-09225.title: Barycentric alignment for instance-level comparison of neural representations
arxiv-2602-09225.creator: Shreya Saha, Zoe Wanying He, Meenakshi Khosla
arxiv-2602-09225.description: Abstract Comparing representations across neural networks is challenging because representations admit symmetries, such as arbitrary reordering of units or rotations of activation space, that obscure underlying equivalence between models. We introduce a barycentric alignment framework that quotients out these nuisance symmetries to construct a universal embedding space across many models.

pmc-10716941.creator: Jérôme R Lechien, Stéphane Hans
pmc-10716941.description: ObjectiveTo investigate epidemiological, clinical and oncological outcomes of patients with laryngeal verrucous carcinomas (LVC).MethodsTwo independent authors investigated PubMed, Scopus and Cochrane Library for studies dedicated to epidemiological, clinical and oncological outcomes of patients with LVC. The following outcomes were investigated with PRISMA criteria: age; gender; tobacco/alcohol consumption; HPV infection; anatomical, pathological, therapeutic and survival outcomes.

pmc-11640900.title: Dysbindin-1 Mutation Alters Prefrontal Cortex Extracellular Glutamate and Dopamine In Vivo
pmc-11640900.creator: Karen K Szumlinski, Michael C Datko, Kevin D Lominac, J David Jentsch, Frank Schmitz, Osama Abulseoud
pmc-11640900.description: Elevated risk for schizophrenia is associated with a variation in the DTNBP1 gene encoding dysbindin-1, which may underpin cognitive impairments in this prevalent neuropsychiatric disorder. The cognitive symptoms of schizophrenia involve anomalies in glutamate and dopamine signaling, particularly within the prefrontal cortex (PFC).

pmc-12430090.title: Polar Cryogenic Impact Behavior of Selective Laser Melted Ti-6Al-4V Alloy: Effects of Scanning Strategies and Notch Orientation
pmc-12430090.creator: Hantao Chen, Wenyong Guo, Xiaofeng Li, Xinglong Pan, Jianxiang Zhang, Li Yu, Yan Zeng
pmc-12430090.description: The anisotropic mechanical properties of selective laser melting (SLM)-processed Ti-6Al-4V (TC4) alloy hinder its deployment in polar marine equipment. This study systematically probes the relationships between laser scanning strategies (unidirectional vs. 67°-rotated scanning between layers), notch orientation (governing loading direction), and cryogenic impact energy of SLM-TC4.

pmc-12437464.title: Manic episodes triggered by weight loss in a patient with bipolar disorder: the importance of integrated lifestyle interventions in psychiatric care
pmc-12437464.creator: D De Francesco, S Cipolla, P Catapano, D Vozza, R Monda, M C Della Corte, R Murolo, V De Santis, F Perris, F Catapano
pmc-12437464.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionWorldwide, obesity has become a major public health issue, affecting over 650 million people, and individuals with severe mental disorders (SMD) are disproportionately affected by higher rates of obesity and metabolic syndrome (MetS). These patients often face significant barriers to improving their lifestyle, including the metabolic side effects of psychiatric medications, which are associated with weight gain, insulin resistance, and dyslipidemia. Moreover, psychiatric patients frequently encounter challenges when seeking care, often due to the stigma surrounding mental illness.

pmc-12629407.title: Association Between Serum Vitamin D Levels and Visceral Adipose Tissue in Older Adults in Iran: A Cross-Sectional Study From the Amirkola Health and Aging Project
pmc-12629407.creator: Marie Behnamzade, Reza Adabi, Manouchehr Ashrafpour, Reza Ghadimi, Ali Bijani, Seyed Reza Hosseini
pmc-12629407.description: The relationship between vitamin D status and visceral adiposity among older adults remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the association between serum vitamin D levels and visceral adipose tissue (VAT) among older Iranian adults. This cross-sectional study included older adults aged ≥ 60 years from the Amirkola Health and Aging Project.

pmc-13232499.title: Ensemble-based genomic prediction for maize flowering time improves prediction accuracy and reveals novel insights into trait genetic variation
pmc-13232499.creator: Shunichiro Tomura, Owen Powell, Melanie J Wilkinson, Mark Cooper, P Ingvarsson
pmc-13232499.description: While various genomic prediction models have been evaluated for their potential to accelerate genetic gain for multiple traits, no individual genomic prediction model has outperformed all others across all applications. As an alternative approach, ensembles of multiple individual genomic prediction models can be applied to utilize the complementary strengths of individual prediction models and offset the prediction errors of each.

pmc-13604090.title: From Biological Models to Industrial Production: How Industry 4.0 Enables the Manufacturability and Scalability of Biomimetic Design
pmc-13604090.creator: Alaeddin Koska
pmc-13604090.description: The industrial relevance of biomimetic design rests on whether a biological principle can be converted into an engineering solution that is manufacturable, verifiable, scalable, and traceable in operation. This critical integrative review considers that problem from a production-management perspective and examines the contribution of Industry 4.0 technologies to design, validation, manufacture, and industrial use.

uslaw-usc-t16-s7603.title: 16 U.S.C. § 760–3 — Establishment of trout hatchery in Pisgah National Forest
uslaw-usc-t16-s7603.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s7603.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 9A (Preservation Of Fishery Resources). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior, after consulting with the Secretary of Agriculture, shall establish, construct, equip, operate, and maintain a trout hatchery at an appropriate location on the Davidson River in the Pisgah National Forest, North Carolina.
